Our findings reveal a striking phenomenon: depending on the interplay between the strength of the periodic drive and synaptic plasticity, the system's phase diagram can give rise to a region where, once both inputs are removed, the collective dynamics spontaneously settles into a limit cycle. This suggests that periodic drives can imprint lasting rhythmic patterns into the network through plasticity, effectively teaching it to oscillate on its own. Numerical simulations on finite size systems show that the limit cycle phase can be easily detected on single-sample trajectories, while averaged curves are affected by strong finite size effects due to sample-to-sample fluctuations of the period of the limit cycles.
summary: 当暴露于不相干的周期性输入和类似赫布的突触可塑性时，我们研究高维非线性动力系统。我们的发现揭示了一个惊人的现象：根据周期性驱动强度和突触可塑性之间的相互作用，系统的相图可以产生一个区域，在该区域中，一旦两个输入都被移除，集体动力学就会自发地陷入极限循环。这表明周期性驱动可以通过可塑性将持久的节奏模式印入网络，有效地教会它自行振荡。有限尺寸系统的数值模拟表明，在单样本轨迹上可以很容易地检测到极限环相位，而平均曲线由于极限环周期的样本间波动而受到强烈的有限尺寸效应的影响。

title: Quantum oscillation fingerprints of altermagnetism in hole-doped RuO2
abstract: Altermagnetism, characterized by its ferromagnetism-like spin-splitting band structure and antiferromagnetism-like magnetic order, has garnered considerable attention recently. Although hole doping may promote magnetism in the debated altermagnet candidate RuO2, the evolution of its electronic and magnetic properties under hole doping remains poorly understood. Based on first-principles calculations, we employ quantum oscillations to study hole-doped RuO2. We find that hole doping can enhance spin splitting and reconstruct the Fermi surface in RuO2, which is revealed by the angle-dependent quantum oscillation frequency. By tracking a pair of closed Fermi-surface pockets, we identify a meaningful correlation between the magnetic moment of Ru and a quantum-oscillation-based signature of spin splitting. This correlation follows a quasi-linear trend over a broad doping range, which can be captured by a minimal two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic model. In addition, the hole-doped RuO2 exhibits a transition from a nonmagnetic to an altermagnetic state via an intermediate state. The quasi-linear correlation through quantum oscillation and the distinct quantum oscillation frequency of the stable altermagnetic state can serve as useful signatures for identifying the altermagnetic state in RuO2. Our results provide a comprehensive framework for understanding hole-doped RuO2, offering new insights into altermagnetic transitions and their identification.
summary:
交变磁学以其类铁磁性的自旋分裂能带结构和类反铁磁性的磁序为特征，近年来引起了人们的广泛关注。尽管空穴掺杂可能会促进有争议的交替磁体候选物 RuO2 的磁性，但空穴掺杂下其电子和磁性特性的演变仍然知之甚少。基于第一性原理计算，我们利用量子振荡来研究空穴掺杂RuO2。我们发现，空穴掺杂可以增强 RuO2 中的自旋分裂并重建费米表面，这可以通过角度相关的量子振荡频率来揭示。通过跟踪一对封闭的费米表面口袋，我们确定了 Ru 的磁矩与基于量子振荡的自旋分裂特征之间的有意义的相关性。这种相关性在很宽的掺杂范围内遵循准线性趋势，可以通过最小二维 d 波交磁模型来捕获。此外，空穴掺杂的RuO2表现出通过中间态从非磁性态到交变磁性态的转变。

通过量子振荡的准线性相关性和稳定交变磁态的独特量子振荡频率可以作为识别 RuO2 中交变磁态的有用特征。我们的研究结果为理解空穴掺杂 RuO2 提供了一个全面的框架，为交变磁跃迁及其识别提供了新的见解。

title: Control of morphology and topology in a lattice model of branching morphogenesis
abstract: We present a lattice model for morphogen-controlled branching morphogenesis which combines ideas and concepts from non-equilibrium physics and developmental biology. In this model, the stochastic occupation dynamics of cells is coupled with signaling molecules (morphogens) produced by the cells. We investigate growth patterns governed by morphogen concentration gradients, spanning regimes ranging from the diffusion-limited aggregation limit to the stochastic surface growth (Eden model) limit. Moreover, we introduce control over topology by a local operator and study growth, degrowth, and steady-state dynamics of branched patterns. The topology-preserving steady-state clusters exhibit a power-law scaling of radius of gyration with cluster size, yielding the exponents $0.68\pm0.01$ in square lattice and $0.67\pm 0.01$ in hexagonal lattice.
summary: 我们提出了一种形态发生素控制的分支形态发生的晶格模型，该模型结合了非平衡物理学和发育生物学的思想和概念。在该模型中，细胞的随机占据动态与细胞产生的信号分子（形态发生素）耦合。我们研究了由形态发生素浓度梯度控制的生长模式，涵盖从扩散限制聚集极限到随机表面生长（伊甸园模型）极限的范围。此外，我们引入了局部算子对拓扑的控制，并研究了分支模式的增长、去增长和稳态动态。保持拓扑的稳态簇表现出回转半径随簇大小的幂律缩放，​​在方格中产生指数$0.68\pm0.01$，在六方格中产生指数$0.67\pm 0.01$。

title: A General Model of Interfacial Chemical Equilibrium in Phase-Field Method
abstract: We report a new approach to interfacial equilibria among multiple solution phases in the phase-field method. It employs auxiliary non-conserved variables to describe the composition differences among different phases, and their temporal evolution is driven by the differences among different chemical diffusional potentials. It is reduced to the Wheeler-Boettinger-McFadden (WBM) model of equal interfacial chemical compositions and to the Kim-Kim-Suzuki (KKS) model of equal interfacial chemical diffusion potentials as two limiting cases. It can directly incorporate thermodynamic databases without any further approximations and simplifications. It is generally applicable to a wide range of problems involving composition evolution and chemical equilibria, including processes such as interdiffusion between two ordered phases not sharing any common composition range, which would pose difficulty to the existing treatments using WBM and KKS models.
summary: 我们报告了相场方法中多个溶液相之间界面平衡的新方法。它采用辅助非保守变量来描述不同相之间的组成差异，并且它们的时间演化由不同化学扩散势之间的差异驱动。作为两种极限情况，它被简化为相等界面化学成分的 Wheeler-Boettinger-McFadden (WBM) 模型和相等界面化学扩散势的 Kim-Kim-Suzuki (KKS) 模型。它可以直接合并热力学数据库，无需任何进一步的近似和简化。它通常适用于涉及成分演化和化学平衡的广泛问题，包括不共享任何共同成分范围的两个有序相之间的相互扩散等过程，这会给使用 WBM 和 KKS 模型的现有处理带来困难。

title: Sign-optimized Quantum Monte Carlo
abstract: The sign problem breaks the polynomial scaling of Quantum Monte Carlo methods. We alleviate it by rotation of the local basis of the Hilbert space, such that the phase of off-diagonal matrix elements of the rotated Hamiltonian is minimized. These minima coincide with optima of the average sign. We benchmark our method for frustrated Heisenberg antiferromagnets in one dimension and on the two-dimensional maple-leaf lattice. Our approach reveals more efficient bases with improved sign in a large part of the parameter space for all models considered, enabling us to reach lower temperatures, on par with state-of-the-art numerical linked cluster expansions which we directly compare to.
summary: 符号问题打破了量子蒙特卡罗方法的多项式缩放。我们通过旋转希尔伯特空间的局部基来缓解它，使得旋转哈密顿量的非对角矩阵元素的相位最小化。这些最小值与平均符号的最优值一致。我们在一维和二维枫叶晶格上对受挫海森堡反铁磁体的方法进行了基准测试。我们的方法揭示了更有效的基础，在所有考虑的模型的大部分参数空间中具有改进的符号，使我们能够达到更低的温度，与我们直接比较的最先进的数值链接簇扩展相当。

title: Anyon Condensation In Symmetry-Enriched Topological Phases: $G$-Grading of Multifusion Categories
abstract: Although anyon condensation is a standard mechanism for relating topological orders, anyon condensation in symmetry-enriched topological (SET) phases is more intricate because the condensate must also be compatible with the global symmetry. We study symmetry-preserving anyon condensation in SET phases described by the enlarged Hu-Geer-Wu (HGW) string-net model with multifusion-category input data. We show that a $G$-preserving condensation is characterized by a compatible grading of the input multifusion category, and that this grading constructs the multifusion-category input of the child SET phase. To make this construction concrete, we consider the case where the relevant data come from a finite group extension $E$ of $G$ by $N$: an $E$-graded fusion category induces a $G$-SET input by passing to the quotient symmetry $G$, and the resulting input naturally carries a compatible $N$-grading that implements the further condensation inside the SET phase while preserving $G$. We illustrate the construction using three quantum-double examples: the trivial extension $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$, the non-Abelian semidirect product $S_3$, and the nontrivial central extension $\mathbb{Z}_4$. The $\mathbb{Z}_4$ example further shows that symmetry fractionalized anyons do not obstruct symmetry-preserving condensation once the condensate is treated as a physical coherent state.
summary:
尽管任意子凝聚是关联拓扑序的标准机制，但对称性丰富的拓扑 (SET) 相中的任意子凝聚更为复杂，因为凝聚也必须与全局对称性兼容。我们研究了由具有多融合类别输入数据的放大 Hu-Geer-Wu (HGW) 弦网模型描述的 SET 相中保对称任意子凝聚。我们证明了 $G$ 保留凝结的特征是输入多重融合类别的兼容分级，并且该分级构造了子 SET 阶段的多重融合类别输入。为了使这种构造具体化，我们考虑相关数据来自 $G$ 通过 $N$ 的有限群扩展 $E$ 的情况：$E$ 分级融合类别通过传递到商对称性 $G$ 来引入 $G$-SET 输入，并且所得输入自然带有兼容的 $N$ 分级，该分级在保留 $G$ 的同时实现了 SET 阶段内的进一步凝聚。

我们使用三个量子双精度示例来说明构造：平凡扩展 $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$、非阿贝尔半直积 $S_3$ 和非平凡中心扩展 $\mathbb{Z}_4$。 $\mathbb{Z}_4$ 的例子进一步表明，一旦凝聚态被视为物理相干态，对称分式任意子就不会阻碍对称性保持凝聚态。

title: Exact Holomorphic Cayley Lumps in Eight Dimensions
abstract: A class of exact self-dual solutions is constructed for an eight-dimensional sigma model describing four-dimensional embeddings in Euclidean space. The theory admits a Spin(7)-invariant Cayley four-form that generates a Bogomolny-type bound for the Nambu-Goto action. The saturation of this bound leads to a first-order self-duality equation for embedding coordinates. A quaternionic polynomial ansatz has been shown to fail systematically by a residual sign mismatch, indicating an intrinsic algebraic obstruction. By contrast, the holomorphic embeddings of C^2 into C^4 satisfy the self-duality equation identically. The relationship between the present construction and the earlier work of Corrigan et al. on higher-dimensional self-duality and Gauntlett et al. on calibrated branes is discussed. Computer algebraic calculations using all 480 admissible octonionic bases show that only a small subset calibrates a given holomorphic embedding.
summary: 为描述欧几里德空间中四维嵌入的八维西格玛模型构造了一类精确自对偶解。该理论承认 Spin(7) 不变的凯莱四形式，它为 Nambu-Goto 作用生成 Bogomolny 型界限。该界限的饱和导致嵌入坐标的一阶自对偶方程。四元多项式 ansatz 已被证明会因残余符号不匹配而系统地失败，这表明存在内在代数障碍。相比之下，C^2 到 C^4 的全纯嵌入同样满足自对偶方程。目前的结构与 Corrigan 等人的早期工作之间的关系。关于高维自二元性和 Gauntlett 等人。讨论了校准膜。使用所有 480 个可接受的八元基的计算机代数计算表明，只有一小部分子集校准给定的全纯嵌入。

title: Comments on deformed phase-space cosmology, SUSY and black holes
abstract: This paper presents the construction of the supersymmetric (SUSY) deformed version of the time dependent metric that describes the interior of the Schwarzschild BH. First, the noncommutative bosonic model is constructed by inducing the deformation in the minisuperspace coordinates and the associated canonical momentum. Following the methods of SUSY quantum mechanics, the supercharges of the deformed models are constructed and the deformed SUSY Wheeler-DeWitt equation is obtained. The classical dynamics are also obtained using the WKB approximation, we find the classical solutions and the conditions to satisfy the Hamiltonian constraint for both the SUSY and bosonic cases. Finally, the effects of the deformation in the context of deformed phase space cosmology and black holes are discussed.
summary: 本文提出了描述史瓦西 BH 内部的时间相关度量的超对称 (SUSY) 变形版本的构造。首先，通过引入微超空间坐标中的变形和相关的正则动量来构建非交换玻色子模型。遵循SUSY量子力学的方法，构造变形模型的增压，得到变形的SUSY Wheeler-DeWitt方程。经典动力学也可以使用 WKB 近似获得，我们找到了 SUSY 和玻色子情况下的经典解和满足哈密顿约束的条件。最后，讨论了变形相空间宇宙学和黑洞背景下的变形效应。

title: Tensor Catalyzed Decoherence of Primordial Scalar Fluctuations
abstract: We provide the first complete calculation of the leading contribution to the decoherence of primordial fluctuations in the scalar part of the metric fluctuations within simplest, single-clock, inflationary models, assuming decoherence comes from gravitational interactions with an environment made up of the other, unmeasured, short-wavelength scalar and tensor modes. We include the contributions from {\it all} of the contributing interactions at leading order in powers of $(H/M_p)^2$ and of the slow-roll parameter $\epsilon_1$. Unlike all extant calculations in the literature we find a result that is {\it not} slow-roll suppressed (and so is the same order of magnitude as tensor-mode decoherence). The difference arises because the dominant decoherence comes from interactions that involve {\it both} the tensor and scalar environments simultaneously (and so are missed when they are examined separately). We verify that the leading contributions to decoherence are UV finite (as they must be). We confirm that the interactions driving decoherence become time-local and Gaussian in the deep super-Hubble inflationary regime and show how this can be used to reliably compute the evolution of the purity in the late-time regime relevant for observations (where naive perturbation theory is known to break down). The same derivation shows explicitly why the effects that undermine perturbation theory for decoherence do not also undermine the basic inflationary prediction for the amplitude of primordial fluctuations (in agreement with general arguments).2
summary:
我们首次完整计算了最简单的单时钟暴胀模型中度量涨落标量部分的原始涨落退相干的主要贡献，假设退相干来自与由其他未测量的短波长标量和张量模式组成的环境的引力相互作用。我们将来自 {\it all} 的贡献交互作用的贡献包含在 $(H/M_p)^2$ 的幂中以及慢滚参数 $\epsilon_1$ 的主导顺序中。与文献中所有现有的计算不同，我们发现一个结果是慢滚抑制的（因此与张量模式退相干的数量级相同）。之所以会出现这种差异，是因为主要的退相干来自同时涉及张量和标量环境的相互作用（因此在单独检查它们时会被忽略）。我们验证了退相干的主要贡献是 UV 有限的（因为它们必须如此）。

我们确认，在超哈勃暴胀体系中，驱动退相干的相互作用成为时间局部的和高斯的，并展示了如何使用它来可靠地计算与观测相关的后期体系中的纯度演化（已知朴素的摄动理论在该体系中会失效）。同样的推导清楚地表明，为什么破坏退相干微扰理论的效应不会同时破坏对原始波动幅度的基本暴涨预测（与一般论点一致）2。

title: Mass/electric versus NUT/magnetic charges: duality from scattering amplitudes in $D\geq4$ and for all bosonic spins
abstract: We revisit Kerr-NUT metrics and related spin-$s$ fields in $D\geq4$, and study their associated scattering amplitudes. Starting in position space, we highlight the interpretation of mass and (multiple) NUT charges as being associated to distinct solutions of the rotation-deformed radial equation, which is made explicit in Cartesian multi-Kerr-Schild coordinates. This interpretation extends to electromagnetism with magnetic-type charges, and also extends to higher-spin counterparts, in accordance with the classical double or multi copy. We then establish a notion of ``electric-magnetic" duality in higher dimensions, relating mass/electric to NUT/magnetic charges, which generalises the $D=4$ case in a novel manner. For $D\geq6$, this involves the choice where the multiple magnetic charges are equal. The duality is revealed in momentum space, by the 3-point scattering amplitudes that generate the solutions. For all spins, these amplitudes are constructed from a spin-raising operator $\mathcal S_\mu$ and take the form $\varepsilon^{\mu_1\cdots\mu_s}{\mathcal S}_{\mu_1}\cdots {\mathcal S}_{\mu_s}$ acting on a scalar seed. The scalar seed of the electric sector is dual to that of the magnetic sector: where the former's rotation dependence resums to a Bessel function $J_{\frac{D-5}{2}}$, the latter resums to a Bessel function $J_{-\frac{D-5}{2}}$. Finally, we explore the notion of self-duality that arises from this picture. Studying the classical $2\!\mapsto\!2$ amplitudes that determine leading-order scattering, we find no evidence of a higher-dimensional analogue of the integrability of $D=4$ self-dual gravity.
summary:
我们重新审视 $D\geq4$ 中的 Kerr-NUT 度量和相关自旋 $s$ 场，并研究它们相关的散射幅度。从位置空间开始，我们强调质量和（多个）NUT 电荷的解释与旋转变形径向方程的不同解相关，这在笛卡尔多 Kerr-Schild 坐标中是明确的。根据经典的双或多拷贝，这种解释扩展到具有磁型电荷的电磁学，并且还扩展到更高自旋的对应物。然后，我们在更高维度上建立“电磁”对偶性的概念，将质量/电与 NUT/磁荷联系起来，以一种新颖的方式概括了 $D=4$ 的情况。对于 $D\geq6$，这涉及多个磁荷相等的选择。对偶性通过生成解的 3 点散射振幅在动量空间中揭示。对于所有自旋，这些振幅是由自旋提升算子 $\mathcal S_\mu$ 和采用 $\varepsilon^{\mu_1\cdots\mu_s}{\mathcal S}_{\mu_1}\cdots {\mathcal S}_{\mu_s}$ 作用于标量种子的形式。

电扇区的标量种子与磁扇区的标量种子是对偶的：前者的旋转依赖性恢复为贝塞尔函数 $J_{\frac{D-5}{2}}$，后者恢复为贝塞尔函数 $J_{-\frac{D-5}{2}}$。最后，我们探讨了从这幅画中产生的自我二元性的概念。研究决定前导散射的经典 $2\!\mapsto\!2$ 振幅，我们没有发现 $D=4$ 自对偶引力可积性的高维类似物的证据。

title: Overcrowding and the Finite-$N$ Hilbert Space
abstract: Finite-$N$ trace relations reorganize the Hilbert space of gauge-invariant operators beyond the freely generated large-$N$ description. We study this structure using the Hironaka decomposition of the invariant ring of $d$ Hermitian $N\times N$ matrices. We first prove that the primary invariants may always be chosen to be homogeneous single-trace operators. We then show that, for any such choice, a nontrivial secondary invariant must appear by degree $L_{N,d}=2\log_d N+\log_d\log_d N+\mathcal{O}_d(1)$, which is parametrically below the first universal trace identity at degree $N+1$. This is a global overcrowding effect: exponentially many independent short single traces compete for only $1+(d-1)N^2$ algebraically independent coordinates. The overcrowding scale matches the fastest scrambling times expected for fast scramblers. We argue that this agreement of scales is not accidental: overcrowding provides a microscopic algebraic picture of scrambling in matrix models. Low-rank examples show that secondary invariants can distinguish configurations with identical primary data and, for suitable dynamics, label semiclassical sectors connected by instantons. These results identify the Hironaka decomposition as a natural framework for organizing perturbative and intrinsically finite-$N$ information in collective descriptions of gauge theories.
summary:
有限$N$迹关系重新组织了规范不变算子的希尔伯特空间，超出了自由生成的大$N$描述。我们使用 $d$ Hermitian $N\times N$ 矩阵不变环的 Hironaka 分解来研究这种结构。我们首先证明主要不变量可以总是被选择为同构单迹算子。然后我们证明，对于任何这样的选择，一个非平凡的二次不变量必须以 $L_{N,d}=2\log_d N+\log_d\log_d N+\mathcal{O}_d(1)$ 度数出现，它在参数上低于第一个通用迹恒等式 $N+1$ 度数。这是一种全局过度拥挤效应：呈指数级增长的许多独立短单迹线仅争夺 $1+(d-1)N^2$ 代数独立坐标。过度拥挤的规模与快速加扰器预期的最快加扰时间相匹配。我们认为这种尺度上的一致性并非偶然：过度拥挤提供了矩阵模型中扰乱的微观代数图景。低阶示例表明，二次不变量可以区分具有相同主要数据的配置，并且对于合适的动力学，标记由瞬子连接的半经典扇区。

这些结果将 Hironaka 分解确定为在规范理论的集体描述中组织扰动且本质上有限的 N$ 信息的自然框架。

title: Horava Stars Revisited: New Phases of Incompressible Stars and Black Holes, and Buchdahl's Theorem
abstract: I study a particular exact solution for static stars in four-dimensional non-projectable Horava gravity, which has been proposed as a renormalizable gravity model without the ghost problem by abandoning Einstein's equal-footing treatment of space and time through anisotropic scaling with z > 1. Considering the spherically symmetric static black-hole solutions in z = 3 Horava gravity as the exterior spacetimes of stars, I obtain an exact solution for incompressible (i.e., uniform-density) static stars with an arbitrary cosmological constant and isotropic pressure, and lambda=1, in which Birkhoff's theorem holds. For a vanishing cosmological constant, I obtain a modified Buchdahl bound on the maximum compactness for uniform-density stars, which ranges from 4/9 to 1. By contrast, I find that Ultra-Compact Objects (UCOs) with compactness C > 1 also exist with negative pressure while, surprisingly, satisfying all four standard energy conditions. UCOs include the regular (non-singular) black-hole solutions with masses above the extremal black-hole mass. In these solutions, the matter is localized at the timelike core region bounded by the inner horizon, while their exterior metrics are unaffected by the core matter and identical to the corresponding vacuum Horava black-hole solutions. These long-sought regular black-hole solutions are essential manifestations of Birkhoff's theorem in Horava gravity. I also find negative-mass stars with positive pressure that violate all standard energy conditions. Finally, I prove Buchdahl's theorem in non-projectable Horava gravity. The proof uses a weight-monotonicity condition on the average density and Birkhoff's theorem, together with the usual assumption that average density is non-increasing.
summary:
我研究了四维不可投影 Horava 引力中静态恒星的一个特殊精确解，该解被提出为一种可重正化的引力模型，没有幽灵问题，放弃了爱因斯坦通过 z > 1 的各向异性缩放对空间和时间的平等对待。考虑到 z = 3 Horava 引力中的球对称静态黑洞解作为恒星的外部时空，我获得了具有任意宇宙常数和各向同性压力，并且 lambda=1，其中伯克霍夫定理成立。对于消失的宇宙常数，我获得了均匀密度恒星最大致密性的修正布赫达尔界，其范围从 4/9 到 1。相比之下，我发现致密性 C > 1 的超致密天体 (UCO) 也存在负压，同时令人惊讶的是，满足所有四个标准能量条件。 UCO 包括质量高于极值黑洞质量的常规（非奇异）黑洞解。

在这些解中，物质位于以内部视界为界的类时核心区域，而它们的外部度量不受核心物质的影响，并且与相应的真空霍拉瓦黑洞解相同。这些长期寻找的正则黑洞解是霍拉瓦引力中伯克霍夫定理的本质体现。我还发现具有正压力的负质量恒星违反了所有标准能量条件。最后，我证明了不可投影霍拉瓦引力中的布赫达尔定理。该证明使用平均密度的权重单调性条件和伯克霍夫定理，以及平均密度不增加的通常假设。

title: On the Nucleon Effective Mass in Neutron Stars Cooling
abstract: The cooling of neutrons stars, which are composed of ultra-high-density nuclear matter, strongly depends on the equation of state because the dominant cooling sources are neutrinos produced in their interiors. Here, we investigate the cooling properties of neutron stars, focusing on effective nucleon masses, whose impacts have been recently examined in supernova explosion and proto-neutron star cooling. The uncertainties of effective masses originate from the difference in the attractive interaction of scalar meson and the definition of the Dirac and Landau masses. At first, we employ so-called Walecka models that allow these two masses to be introduced within a unified framework and evaluate the resulting cooling curves. Based on the Walecka model, we compute the emissivity of the neutrons and the direct Urca process and their cooling curves. We demonstrate that the Dirac and Landau masses affect cooling of massive neutron stars, although most previous cooling simulations do not distinguish them. We also perform cooling simulations with two realistic equation of states based on relativistic mean-field (RMF) theory, whose differences arise from properties of only effective masses among characteristic parameters. These results are broadly consistent with those obtained from the Walecka models, indicating that the treatment of effective nucleon masses may be an important source of uncertainty in neutron-star cooling.
summary:
由超高密度核物质组成的中子星的冷却很大程度上取决于状态方程，因为主要的冷却源是其内部产生的中微子。在这里，我们研究中子星的冷却特性，重点关注有效核子质量，最近在超新星爆炸和原中子星冷却中研究了其影响。有效质量的不确定性源于标量介子的吸引力相互作用以及狄拉克和朗道质量定义的差异。首先，我们采用所谓的 Walecka 模型，该模型允许将这两个质量引入到统一的框架内，并评估所得的冷却曲线。基于 Walecka 模型，我们计算了中子的发射率和直接 Urca 过程及其冷却曲线。我们证明狄拉克和朗道质量会影响大质量中子星的冷却，尽管之前的大多数冷却模拟并没有区分它们。

我们还使用基于相对论平均场（RMF）理论的两个现实状态方程进行冷却模拟，其差异源于特征参数中仅有效质量的性质。这些结果与从 Walecka 模型获得的结果大致一致，表明有效核子质量的处理可能是中子星冷却不确定性的重要来源。

title: Effects of Curvature-Scalar Coupling on Vacuum Energy in Flat (3+1)-Dimensional Space-Time
abstract: We investigated how a magnetic topological defect affects the vacuum polarization of a charged massive scalar field in a flat $(3+1)$-dimensional space-time. The defect was modeled as an impenetrable to matter field finite-thickness tube with magnetic flux inside. We implemented the most general form of the Robin boundary condition on the surface of the magnetic tube, which enables a fully general analysis of the problem. We have found that in flat spacetime, the total vacuum energy generated by a magnetic topological defect depends on the curvature $\xi$, except for special cases corresponding to the Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions. By contrast, when Robin's general boundary conditions are imposed, the induced vacuum energy acquires an explicit dependence on the curvature coupling $\xi$, which is significant even in flat space-time. A detailed study of the dependence of the effect on the boundary condition parameter has been carried out. The obtained results highlight the nontrivial role played by boundary conditions in vacuum polarization phenomena.
summary: 我们研究了磁拓扑缺陷如何影响平坦 $(3+1)$ 维时空中带电大标量场的真空极化。该缺陷被建模为内部磁通量不可穿透的物质场有限厚度管。我们在磁管表面实现了 Robin 边界条件的最通用形式，这使得能够对问题进行全面的通用分析。我们发现，在平坦时空中，磁拓扑缺陷产生的总真空能量取决于曲率 $\xi$，除了对应于狄利克雷和诺伊曼边界条件的特殊情况。相比之下，当施加 Robin 的一般边界条件时，感应真空能量获得对曲率耦合 $\xi$ 的明确依赖性，即使在平坦时空中，这也很重要。对边界条件参数影响的依赖性进行了详细研究。获得的结果凸显了边界条件在真空极化现象中发挥的重要作用。

title: Standard Model Effective Field Theory and Oscillons
abstract: We show that the inclusion of a dimension-six operator in the Higgs potential has a dramatic impact on the stability of oscillons in the $SU(2)$ bosonic sector of the Standard Model, extending their lifetime by orders of magnitude. This happens for the physical value of the ratio between the Higgs and W boson masses, $m_H/m_W=1.556$ and for the dimension-six operator $O_6 = (\Phi^\dagger \Phi)^3$ whose coupling constant is below the current upper bound.
summary: 我们证明，在希格斯势中包含六维算子对标准模型 $SU(2)$ 玻色子部分中振荡的稳定性具有巨大影响，将其寿命延长了几个数量级。这种情况发生在希格斯玻色子质量与 W 玻色子质量之比的物理值 $m_H/m_W=1.556$ 以及六维运算符 $O_6 = (\Phi^\dagger \Phi)^3$ 上，其耦合常数低于当前上限。

title: $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills thermodynamics from effective field theory
abstract: We compute the weak-coupling free energy density of pure four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills (SYM) theory through second order in the 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$ at finite temperature using effective-field-theory methods. The contribution from the hard scale $T$ is obtained from massless three-loop vacuum diagrams in the full theory, and that from the electric scale $\sqrt{\lambda}\,T$ from a two-loop calculation in the dimensionally reduced three-dimensional effective theory. In contrast to $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM, the theory is asymptotically free: the coupling-renormalization counterterm, together with the EFT unit-operator counterterm, cancels all $1/\epsilon$ poles. The remaining renormalization-scale dependence is fixed by the one-loop beta function. The expansion reproduces earlier results through order $\lambda^{3/2}$, and the order-$\lambda^2$ term is new.
summary: 我们使用有效场理论方法，通过二阶 't Hooft 耦合 $\lambda$ 在有限温度下计算纯四维 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超对称 Yang-Mills (SYM) 理论的弱耦合自由能密度。硬尺度$T$的贡献是在全理论中通过无质量三环真空图获得的，电尺度$\sqrt{\lambda}\,T$的贡献是在降维三维有效理论中通过两环计算获得的。与 $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM 相比，该理论是渐近自由的：耦合重整化反项与 EFT 单位算子反项一起取消所有 $1/\epsilon$ 极点。剩余的重正化尺度依赖性由单循环 beta 函数固定。扩展通过阶 $\lambda^{3/2}$ 重现了早期结果，并且阶 $\lambda^2$ 项是新的。

title: Stability and Chaotic Dynamics in a Nonlinearly Confined ghost-sector Hamiltonian
abstract: We investigate the nonlinear dynamics of a Hamiltonian system containing a ghost degree of freedom coupled to a canonical sector through nonlinear interactions. The model consists of one positive-energy and one negative-energy mode, augmented by quartic and sextic nonlinearities that regularize the large-amplitude behavior of the system. Unlike conventional ghost models, which typically exhibit runaway trajectories due to the indefinite nature of the kinetic energy, the present Hamiltonian possesses a confining nonlinear structure that renders the accessible energy surfaces compact for finite total energy. We derive the equations of motion and analyze the geometric properties of the Hamiltonian flow. Particular attention is devoted to the interplay between local ghost-induced instability and global nonlinear confinement. We show that the sextic contribution dominates the asymptotic dynamics and prevents escape to infinity despite the presence of a negative-energy sector. As a consequence, the model provides a controlled framework for studying bounded dynamics in ghost-coupled systems. The phase-space structure is investigated through numerical integration, Poincaré surfaces of section, and Lyapunov analysis. Depending on the interaction strength and nonlinear couplings, the system exhibits a transition from regular quasi-periodic motion to chaotic dynamics characterized by positive maximal Lyapunov exponents. Remarkably, chaotic trajectories remain confined within compact regions of phase space, yielding a realization of bounded chaotic motion in a ghost-containing Hamiltonian system. These results provide a concrete example of how nonlinear self-interactions can regularize ghost dynamics at the classical level and indicate a useful prototype for studying stability, confinement, and chaos in nonstandard Hamiltonian theories.
summary:
我们研究了哈密顿系统的非线性动力学，该系统包含通过非线性相互作用耦合到规范扇区的幽灵自由度。该模型由一种正能量模式和一种负能量模式组成，并通过四次和六次非线性增强，从而规范系统的大振幅行为。与传统的幽灵模型不同，传统的幽灵模型通常由于动能的不确定性而表现出失控轨迹，而本哈密顿量具有有限的非线性结构，可以使可访问的能量表面紧凑以实现有限的总能量。我们推导出运动方程并分析哈密顿流的几何特性。特别关注局部幽灵引起的不稳定性和全局非线性限制之间的相互作用。我们表明，尽管存在负能量扇区，但六性贡献在渐近动力学中占主导地位，并阻止逃逸到无穷大。因此，该模型为研究鬼耦合系统中的有界动力学提供了一个受控框架。

通过数值积分、庞加莱截面曲面和李雅普诺夫分析来研究相空间结构。根据相互作用强度和非线性耦合，系统表现出从规则准周期运动到以正最大 Lyapunov 指数为特征的混沌动力学的转变。值得注意的是，混沌轨迹仍然被限制在相空间的紧凑区域内，从而在包含幽灵的哈密顿系统中实现了有界混沌运动。这些结果提供了一个具体的例子，说明非线性自相互作用如何在经典水平上规范幽灵动力学，并为研究非标准哈密顿理论中的稳定性、限制和混沌提供了一个有用的原型。

title: Freezing Swampland: A Krylov Complexity Criterion for the Weak Gravity Conjecture
abstract: We propose a quantum-information-theoretic perspective on the Weak Gravity Conjecture through the behavior of Krylov spread complexity. For a charged thermofield double state holographically dual to an AdS Reissner--Nordström black hole, we show that the extremal limit on the black-hole side is accompanied by an effective freezing of Krylov spreading. In this regime, the return amplitude becomes effectively a pure phase, and the dual quantum state ceases to spread nontrivially in Krylov space. We then incorporate charged matter and study the effect of Schwinger pair production in the near-horizon region. Within this semiclassical near-extremal analysis, the frozen behavior is lifted once the discharge channel is opened, and the dynamics become nontrivial again. This suggests that the Weak Gravity Conjecture may admit a complexity-based interpretation in terms of the absence of exact freezing in the presence of an available discharge channel. More broadly, our results point to a new connection between the swampland program, black-hole physics, and quantum information theory.
summary: 我们通过克雷洛夫传播复杂性的行为提出了弱引力猜想的量子信息理论视角。对于与 AdS Reissner-Nordström 黑洞双态全息对偶的带电热场双态，我们表明黑洞一侧的极值极限伴随着 Krylov 扩散的有效冻结。在这种情况下，返回振幅实际上变成了纯相位，并且双量子态不再在克雷洛夫空间中非平凡地传播。然后，我们结合带电物质并研究近地平线区域施温格电子对产生的影响。在这种半经典的近极值分析中，一旦放电通道打开，冻结行为就会解除，并且动力学再次变得重要。这表明弱重力猜想可能承认在存在可用排放通道的情况下不存在精确冻结的基于复杂性的解释。更广泛地说，我们的结果指出了沼泽计划、黑洞物理学和量子信息理论之间的新联系。

title: The extremal Reissner-Nordström throat from non extremal near horizon expansions
abstract: The near horizon region of a non extremal black hole has a universal Rindler form, but the strict horizon limit is not an ordinary Lorentzian geometry. In the String Carroll expansion of this non extremal near horizon metric,the transverse angular directions form a base and the time-radial Rindler directions appear as a distinguished two-dimensional longitudinal sector fibered over this base. We study how this String Carroll expansion behaves for the Reissner-Nordström (RN) black hole as the extremal limit is approached, where the expected near horizon geometry is the Lorentzian $AdS_2 \times S^2$ throat. We show that while for the four-dimensional non extremal RN geometry, the String Carroll expansion correctly captures the near horizon Rindler region, it is not sufficient to recover the extremal $AdS_2 \times S^2$ throat. The reason is that the higher order terms, which are suppressed in the String Carroll expansion, become essential in the extremal limit. We show that in Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates, the required contribution appears at second order and restores the radial dependence needed for the $AdS_2$ geometry. The extremal $AdS_2 \times S^2$ throat is then obtained as the zero-temperature limit of the scaled throat geometry. In static coordinates, the temporal sector of the extremal throat geometry can be obtained from a second order near horizon expansion, but the radial sector cannot be obtained from any finite order truncation and requires contributions from all orders in the near horizon expansion.
summary:
非极值黑洞的近视界区域具有通用的 Rindler 形式，但严格的视界限制不是普通的洛伦兹几何。在这种非极值近水平度量的弦卡罗尔展开中，横向角方向形成基底，时间径向林德勒方向表现为在该基底上纤维化的独特二维纵向扇区。我们研究了当接近极值极限时，Reissner-Nordström (RN) 黑洞的弦卡罗尔展开如何表现，其中预期的近地平线几何形状是洛伦兹 $AdS_2 \times S^2$ 喉部。我们表明，虽然对于四维非极值 RN 几何结构，String Carroll 展开正确地捕获了近地平线 Rindler 区域，但不足以恢复极值 $AdS_2 \times S^2$ 喉咙。原因是在字符串卡罗尔展开中被抑制的高阶项在极值极限中变得至关重要。我们表明，在爱丁顿-芬克尔斯坦坐标中，所需的贡献出现在二阶并恢复 $AdS_2$ 几何所需的径向依赖性。

然后获得极值 $AdS_2 \times S^2$ 喉部，作为缩放喉部几何形状的零温度极限。在静态坐标中，极值喉道几何形状的时间扇区可以通过二阶近地平线扩展获得，但径向扇区不能通过任何有限阶截断获得，并且需要近地平线扩展中所有阶次的贡献。

title: R-Twisting, Fibered Knots, and Gauge Theories
abstract: We argue that R-twisting implies the Seiberg-Witten curves of 4d Argyres-Douglas theories could be combined with the R-twisted circle to form the mapping tori of torus knots, inspired by Milnor fibration theorem. Then 3d gauge theories labeled by mapping tori are generated, which in the IR capture 4d BPS spectrum and mutations. This construction addresses the boundary problem of the domain wall approach in \cite{Cecotti:2011iy}. These 3d theories show a supersymmetry enhancement, and are related to 3d rank zero theories.
summary: 我们认为，受 Milnor 纤维化定理的启发，R 扭转意味着 4d Argyres-Douglas 理论的 Seiberg-Witten 曲线可以与 R 扭转圆相结合，形成环面结的映射环面。然后生成由映射环面标记的 3d 规范理论，该理论在 IR 中捕获 4d BPS 光谱和突变。这种结构解决了 \cite{Cecotti:2011iy} 中域壁方法的边界问题。这些 3d 理论显示出超对称性增强，并且与 3d 零阶理论相关。

title: Light-like retarded correlators and the horizon
abstract: We show that retarded correlators in conformal field theories of scalar primary operators evaluated at finite temperature using $AdS/CFT$ scale anomalously at large light like momenta. The anomalous scaling depends on the curvature of the horizon. Setting the momenta equal to the frequency $\omega$, the retarded correlator for black holes with planar horizons scales as $\omega^{\frac{2}{d+2} (2\Delta - d) }$ as opposed to the scaling behaviour of $\omega^{2\Delta - d}$ expected by dimensional analysis at generic fixed momenta and large frequencies. $\Delta$ is the dimension of the primary and $d$, the number of space-time dimensions. For black holes with spherical and hyperbolic horizons when the frequency squared equals the Casimir along the horizon, the retarded correlator scales as $\omega^{\frac{2\Delta -d}{2} }$. We establish this using exact results in $d=2$, and a numerical analysis of the Heun equation for the $AdS_5$ planar black hole and finally using the WKB approximation in general $d$. The exact result for black holes with hyperbolic horizon as well as the analysis at large $d$ provides additional checks for the anomalous scaling behaviour. Finally we evaluate the anomalous scaling exponent for the stress tensor correlator in all its 3 channels.
summary:
我们证明了标量主算子的共形场论中的延迟相关器在有限温度下使用 $AdS/CFT$ 进行评估，在大光动量下异常缩放。异常缩放取决于地平线的曲率。将动量设置为等于频率 $\omega$，具有平面视界的黑洞的延迟相关器缩放为 $\omega^{\frac{2}{d+2} (2\Delta - d) }$，这与一般固定动量和大频率下维度分析预期的 $\omega^{2\Delta - d}$ 缩放行为相反。 $\Delta$ 是主维数，$d$ 是时空维数。对于具有球形和双曲视界的黑洞，当频率平方等于视界上的卡西米尔时，延迟相关器的比例为 $\omega^{\frac{2\Delta -d}{2} }$。我们使用 $d=2$ 中的精确结果以及 $AdS_5$ 平面黑洞的 Heun 方程的数值分析，最后使用一般 $d$ 中的 WKB 近似来建立这一点。双曲视界黑洞的精确结果以及大$d$ 的分析为异常尺度行为提供了额外的检查。

最后，我们评估所有 3 个通道中应力张量相关器的异常缩放指数。

title: Dynamical Quarks in the Ensemble of Center Vortices with Monopole Defects: Color Confinement Beyond External Probes
abstract: We consider the interaction of dynamical quarks with the ensemble of oriented and nonoriented center vortices proposed to describe flux-tube formation between quark probes in pure Yang-Mills theory. The quark sector is described in terms of bosonized color currents. Within this fluid-like framework, the infrared vortex--monopole condensate restricts finite-energy configurations to be color neutral. Furthermore, neutral distributions of constituent color densities embedded in the condensate generate frustrated regions, providing a mechanism for their localization into finite-size configurations. The resulting picture is consistent with lattice evidence indicating that center vortices play a central role in shaping the hadron spectrum.
summary: 我们考虑动力夸克与定向和非定向中心涡流整体的相互作用，提出来描述纯杨米尔斯理论中夸克探针之间的通量管形成。夸克扇区是用玻色色流来描述的。在这种类似流体的框架内，红外涡旋单极凝聚体将有限能量配置限制为颜色中性。此外，嵌入冷凝物中的成分颜色密度的中性分布会产生受挫区域，从而提供了将其定位到有限尺寸配置中的机制。所得图像与晶格证据一致，表明中心涡旋在塑造强子谱中发挥着核心作用。

title: General Properties of the Thermo-Metric for CV event manifolds and the magnetization combinatorial scheme
abstract: Following previous results recently obtained by us, on Information Geometry versus Geometrical Thermodynamics and on the exact calculation of partition functions for extended Souriau Gibbs distributions on Calabi Vesentini manifolds, we study the differential geometry of the corresponding thermo-metrics. A general intriguing scheme is discovered and put into evidence. A small yet significant difference, distinguishes the even from the odd dimensional instance of the microscopic CV manifolds. Apart from that the complete thermo-space is flat when no constraint is introduced. Freezing the magnetic fields, which can be done according to complicated combinatorials, forces the thermo-system to evolve on curved submanifolds of the thermo--space that have a structure depending only on the length of the $n-1$ chain of frozen contiguous magnetic fields. The behavior of Riemann tensor components for such spaces is codified by a symmetric matrix with peculiar behavior along special symmetrically arranged submanifolds that, might be responsible for the generation of curvature walls and for the categorical partitioning of the thermo space. The embedding of this curved submanifold into $\mathbb{R}^{2n-1}$ can be traced back to the vanishing of magnetic fields and, in this case, the flat metric on $\mathbb{R}^{2n-1}$ is the $\mathfrak{a}_{2n-1}$ simple Lie algebra Cartan matrix. In another version the flat embedding reveals the geometric interpretation of the $n$-manifold as a generalized translation hypersurface. The boundary at infinity has a hypercube structure whose face central points and vertices appear, numerically, to be the end-points of all geodesics depending only on their angular slope at the start. This general feature is reminiscent of the causal structure at infinity of Lorentzian space-times and of Penrose diagrams.
summary:
根据我们最近获得的信息几何与几何热力学以及 Calabi Vesentini 流形上扩展 Souriau Gibbs 分布的配分函数的精确计算结果，我们研究了相应测温的微分几何。一个普遍有趣的计划被发现并付诸证据。微小但显着的差异区分了微观 CV 流形的偶数维实例和奇数维实例。除此之外，当不引入约束时，完整的热空间是平坦的。冻结磁场可以根据复杂的组合来实现，迫使热系统在热空间的弯曲子流形上演化，该子流形的结构仅取决于冻结的连续磁场$n-1$链的长度。此类空间的黎曼张量分量的行为由对称矩阵编码，该对称矩阵具有沿特殊对称排列的子流形的特殊行为，这可能负责曲率壁的生成和热空间的分类划分。

这个弯曲子流形嵌入$\mathbb{R}^{2n-1}$可以追溯到磁场的消失，在这种情况下，$\mathbb{R}^{2n-1}$上的平面度量是$\mathfrak{a}_{2n-1}$简单李代数嘉当矩阵。在另一个版本中，平面嵌入揭示了 $n$ 流形作为广义平移超曲面的几何解释。无穷远边界具有超立方体结构，其面中心点和顶点在数字上似乎是所有测地线的端点，仅取决于它们在开始时的角斜率。这一普遍特征让人想起洛伦兹时空和彭罗斯图的无限因果结构。

title: Supersymmetric Moduli Space and Vacua with Vector Fields in $D=4$ Gauged $\mathcal{N}=8$ Supergravity
abstract: When fermions are taken to be anti-periodic along a spacelike $S^1$ in $AdS_4$, certain ground states of the supergravity theory are described by AdS-soliton-like spacetimes. We study these geometries within the purely dilatonic STU model obtained from the compactification of M-theory on $S^7$ in the presence of non-trivial gauge fields. The resulting configurations define a rich family of everywhere regular supersymmetric vacua that holographically describe strongly coupled ``confining'' gauge theories in three dimensions. We provide a complete characterization of the moduli space of supersymmetric solutions in terms of the vacuum expectation values of the dimension-one operators of the truncation.
summary: 当费米子被认为沿着$AdS_4$中的类空间$S^1$是反周期的时，超引力理论的某些基态由类AdS孤子时空来描述。我们在纯膨胀 STU 模型中研究这些几何形状，该模型是在存在非平凡规范场的情况下在 $S^7$ 上对 M 理论进行紧化而获得的。由此产生的配置定义了丰富的无处不在的规则超对称真空家族，它们全息地描述了三维强耦合“限制”规范理论。我们根据截断的一维算子的真空期望值提供了超对称解的模空间的完整表征。

title: Spin-resolved double-trace thermal coefficients in holography
abstract: It was previously shown that the stress-tensor sector of the OPE, together with the KMS condition, fixes holographic thermal two-point functions at vanishing spatial separation. We extend this construction to nonzero spatial separation, where the KMS condition leaves a residual ambiguity that depends only on the spatial separation. We show that this ambiguity is fixed by the zero-frequency bulk wave equation, which can be solved analytically in terms of Heun functions. This gives an efficient method for computing thermal coefficients of double-trace operators resolved by spin. We also study the Lorentzian analytic structure of the resulting correlator and show that complex bulk-cone singularities which appear at spacelike separation in the stress-tensor sector do not persist in the full two-point function; they are resolved by the double-trace contribution.
summary: 之前的研究表明，OPE 的应力张量扇区与 KMS 条件一起修复了空间分离消失时的全息热两点函数。我们将此构造扩展到非零空间分离，其中 KMS 条件留下仅取决于空间分离的残余模糊度。我们证明了这种模糊性是由零频率体波动方程解决的，该方程可以用 Heun 函数来解析求解。这提供了一种计算自旋解析的双迹算子热系数的有效方法。我们还研究了所得相关器的洛伦兹解析结构，并表明在应力张量扇区中的空间分离处出现的复杂体锥奇点并不存在于完整的两点函数中；它们通过双迹贡献来解决。

title: Near-Light-Cone Nonhydrodynamic Structure from Boosted Hydrodynamics
abstract: Hydrodynamics provides a universal description of many-body systems at long wavelengths. Its long-lived collective excitations, known as hydrodynamic modes, admit long-wavelength expansions whose convergence is encoded in the analytic structure of retarded correlators of conserved quantities in thermal equilibrium. We show that a boost can change which nonhydrodynamic singularity limits such an expansion. At large boost, the relevant singularity originates in the large-momentum, near-light-cone region of the rest-frame spectrum. After removing the Lorentz-factor growth, the rescaled convergence scale is controlled by the microscopic spectral structure of the theory. We explicitly demonstrate this in two examples: relaxation-time kinetic theory and holography.
summary: 流体动力学提供了长波长多体系统的通用描述。其长寿命的集体激发，称为流体动力学模式，允许长波长膨胀，其收敛性被编码在热平衡守恒量的延迟相关器的分析结构中。我们证明，升压可以改变限制这种扩张的非流体动力奇点。在大增强时，相关奇点起源于静止帧光谱的大动量、近光锥区域。去除洛伦兹因子增长后，重新缩放的收敛尺度由理论的微观谱结构控制。我们通过两个例子明确地证明了这一点：弛豫时间动力学理论和全息术。

title: Krylov complexity and spectral density of BMN matrix model
abstract: We use Krylov complexity as a typical diagnostic of quantum many body dynamics in the context of BMN matrix model at large mass gap. We calculate several physical entities, for example, the moments and return amplitudes at large mass deformation. We calculate them for both spread complexity of states as well as Krylov growth of operators in the matrix model. We propose a general expression for the moments at any given order $n$. We also discuss orthogonal polynomials for spread as well as operator Krylov complexity. In the context of the Krylov operator growth we further compute the spectral function and the density of states. A careful analysis of the spectral function near the resonance reveals various IR divergences in addition to the physical collective modes. These collective modes appear to be exceptionally stable due to large mass gap. On the other hand, the UV of the theory appears to be extremely damped due to higher scattering rates. We carefully diagnose these IR divergences near resonance which reveals that these collective modes are in fact non-propagating and should be thought of as diffusion modes or relaxation modes with infinite relaxation time. We also calculate the Krylov variance and Krylov entropy for the matrix model and in particular at early time. The linear early time growth of the Krylov entropy confirms the onset of quantum chaos in the matrix model at large mass gap.
summary:
我们使用 Krylov 复杂度作为大质量间隙 BMN 矩阵模型背景下量子多体动力学的典型诊断。我们计算几个物理实体，例如大质量变形时的力矩和返回幅度。我们针对状态的扩展复杂性以及矩阵模型中算子的 Krylov 增长来计算它们。我们提出了任何给定阶 $n$ 下矩的通用表达式。我们还讨论了扩展的正交多项式以及算子 Krylov 复杂度。在 Krylov 算子增长的背景下，我们进一步计算谱函数和态密度。对共振附近的光谱函数的仔细分析揭示了除了物理集体模式之外的各种红外发散。由于质量间隙较大，这些集体模式显得异常稳定。另一方面，由于较高的散射率，该理论的紫外线似乎受到极大的阻尼。我们仔细诊断这些接近共振的红外发散，这表明这些集体模式实际上是非传播的，应该被认为是扩散模式或具有无限弛豫时间的弛豫模式。

我们还计算了矩阵模型的克雷洛夫方差和克雷洛夫熵，特别是在早期。克雷洛夫熵的线性早期增长证实了大质量间隙下矩阵模型中量子混沌的开始。

title: Nonlocal Cubic Density Gibbs Measures from Bosonic Gibbs States with Three-Body Interactions
abstract: We study the high-temperature mean-field limit of grand-canonical bosonic Gibbs states on the torus with renormalized nonlocal three-body interactions. In dimensions two and three, we construct the limiting nonlinear classical Gibbs measure and prove convergence of the relative free energy and of the reduced density matrices of every fixed order; in three dimensions, a smallness condition on the interaction is imposed. The proof combines the density-channel representation of the interaction with a coherent-state variational method based on the upper-symbol representation of the free Gibbs state. The same framework also contains, as a special case, the homogeneous positive-type model studied by Lewin, Nam, and Rougerie (2021).
summary: 我们研究了具有重正化非局域三体相互作用的圆环上大正则玻色吉布斯态的高温平均场极限。在第二维和第三维上，我们构造了极限非线性经典吉布斯测度，并证明了相对自由能和每个固定阶次的约化密度矩阵的收敛性；在三个维度中，对相互作用施加了微小条件。该证明将相互作用的密度通道表示与基于自由吉布斯态的上符号表示的相干态变分方法结合起来。作为一个特例，同一框架还包含 Lewin、Nam 和 Rougerie（2021）研究的同质正型模型。

title: $\mathcal{P}(Φ)_2$ Theory from many-body quantum Gibbs states
abstract: We derive the $\mathcal{P}(\Phi)_2$ measure on the two-dimensional unit torus as the rigorous limit of many-body quantum Gibbs states. In particular, the quantum model corresponding to the $\Phi^{2p}_2$ measure is formulated in the grand-canonical ensemble with a general symmetric $p$-body interaction potential which is not required to have a factorized form. Unlike in the $\Phi^4_2$ case investigated by Fröhlich--Knowles--Schlein--Sohinger in \cite{FKSS25}, in the treatment of higher-order interactions, Wick renormalization generates a full hierarchy of lower-order interactions which we organize systematically using a graphical formalism. One key ingredient of our analysis is a logarithmic stability estimate for both the nonlocal Hartree functional and the many-body Hamiltonian that is uniform in the interaction range, allowing us to use the positivity of the leading $p$-body interaction to control all lower-order terms generated by the Wick counterterms.
summary: 我们推导出二维单位环面上的 $\mathcal{P}(\Phi)_2$ 测度作为多体量子吉布斯态的严格极限。特别是，对应于 $\Phi^{2p}_2$ 测量的量子模型是在具有一般对称 $p$-体相互作用势的大正则系综中制定的，不需要具有因式分解的形式。与 Fröhlich--Knowles--Schlein-Sohinger 在 \cite{FKSS25} 中研究的 $\Phi^4_2$ 案例不同，在处理高阶相互作用时，Wick 重整化生成了一个完整的低阶相互作用层次结构，我们使用图形形式系统系统地组织它。我们分析的一个关键要素是对非局部 Hartree 泛函和多体哈密顿量的对数稳定性估计，该估计在相互作用范围内是均匀的，使我们能够使用领先的 $p$-body 相互作用的正性来控制 Wick 反项生成的所有低阶项。

title: Explicit higher order rational rogue waves of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation
abstract: The $N$-th order rational rogue wave of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLS), which depends on $2 N-2$ real parameters, has been shown to be impossible to generate by the nonlinear superposition formula. We here generate this sequence by a three-term recurrence relation, each step only requiring the computation of three $N-1$-th order determinants of $2 N-2$ variables, while the previous method requires two determinants of order $2 N$ in $2 N$ variables. This allows us to obtain explicitly the seventh wave with its six arbitrary complex parameters. These very compact expressions open the possibility to investigate the possible existence of new patterns in addition to the already observed ones (concentric rings, polygonal configurations, \dots).
summary: 非线性薛定谔方程 (NLS) 的 $N$ 阶有理流氓波依赖于 $2 N-2$ 实数参数，已被证明不可能通过非线性叠加公式生成。我们在这里通过三项递推关系生成这个序列，每一步只需要计算 $2 N-2$ 变量的三个 $N-1$ 阶行列式，而之前的方法需要 $2 N$ 变量的两个 $2 N$ 阶行列式。这使我们能够明确地获得第七波及其六个任意复数参数。这些非常紧凑的表达式为研究除了已经观察到的模式（同心环、多边形配置、点）之外可能存在的新模式提供了可能性。

title: Localization of quantum systems at Liouville tori
abstract: We consider a collection of pairwise commuting quantum observables in the setting of Berezin--Toeplitz quantization of a closed Kähler manifold and assume that the Arnold--Liouville theorem applies to their principal symbols. We use joint eigensections of these observables to define isometric embeddings of the quantum spaces into $L^2(\Lambda_{a_0})$, where $\Lambda_{a_0}$ is a fixed Liouville torus. These embeddings allow a broad class of quantum observables, including some defined by discontinuous functions, to be realized as sequences of operators on $L^2(\Lambda_{a_0})$ that converge strongly to multiplication operators. We discuss the spectral implications of this convergence and give applications to contractions of Lie algebra representations and to pairs of spectral projections of quantum observables.
summary: 我们在闭凯勒流形的 Berezin-Toeplitz 量子化的背景下考虑成对交换量子可观测量的集合，并假设阿诺德-刘维尔定理适用于它们的主要符号。我们使用这些可观测量的联合特征截面将量子空间的等距嵌入定义为 $L^2(\Lambda_{a_0})$，其中 $\Lambda_{a_0}$ 是固定的刘维尔环面。这些嵌入允许将广泛的量子可观测量（包括由不连续函数定义的一些）实现为 $L^2(\Lambda_{a_0})$ 上的运算符序列，这些运算符强烈收敛于乘法运算符。我们讨论了这种收敛的光谱含义，并给出了李代数表示的收缩和量子可观测量的光谱投影对的应用。

title: A phase transition for the hard sphere model on the hyperbolic plane
abstract: The hard sphere model is a classical model from statistical physics in which particles are represented by equal-sized spheres. Longstanding predictions from the physics literature indicate that in $\mathbb{R}^2$ and $\mathbb{R}^3$ the system undergoes a phase transition, but it remains a major open problem to confirm this. We prove the existence of a phase transition for this model in the hyperbolic plane.
summary: 硬球模型是统计物理学的经典模型，其中粒子由大小相等的球体表示。物理学文献的长期预测表明，在 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 和 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中，系统会经历相变，但证实这一点仍然是一个主要的悬而未决的问题。我们证明了该模型在双曲平面上存在相变。

title: Local Weyl law and length-minimising loops on hyperbolic surfaces
abstract: We study the variance of a local Weyl law over a fixed smooth energy window, when averaged over large Weil--Petersson hyperbolic surfaces. Our results are consistent with the predictions of Berry's random wave model. Our approach allows to explicitly integrate certain test functions which depend on lengths of based geodesic loops, and relate them to the associated lengths of the closed geodesics in their free-homotopy class. We thus utilise the work of Mirzakhani, with exact stationary phase arguments, to identify correct main and error terms, making explicit the asymptotic behaviour of the variance of the local Weyl law. Furthermore, we introduce the geometric notion of length-minimising geodesic loops and sequences, based at a point. We prove a complete characterisation of the topology of these, namely that they are simple. This forms a key ingredient in our study, and yields a new streamlined argument to bound the contributions of remainder terms which depend on lengths of pairs of different short primitive geodesic loops. To illustrate the generality of our results, we further introduce a family of "exploring" loops based at a point, which might be of independent interest.
summary: 我们研究了局部韦尔定律在固定平滑能量窗口上的方差，以及在大韦尔-彼得森双曲曲面上进行平均时的方差。我们的结果与贝里随机波模型的预测一致。我们的方法允许显式地集成某些取决于基础测地线环长度的测试函数，并将它们与自由同伦类中闭合测地线的相关长度相关联。因此，我们利用 Mirzakhani 的工作以及精确的平稳相参数来识别正确的主项和误差项，从而明确了局部 Weyl 定律方差的渐近行为。此外，我们引入了基于一点的长度最小化测地线环和序列的几何概念。我们证明了这些拓扑的完整特征，即它们很简单。这构成了我们研究中的一个关键要素，并产生了一个新的简化论证来限制余项的贡献，这些项取决于不同短测地线环对的长度。为了说明我们结果的普遍性，我们进一步引入了一系列基于某个点的“探索”循环，这可能具有独立的兴趣。

title: A doubled Gordon threshold for palindromic quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators
abstract: We consider one-frequency quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators \[ (H_{v,\alpha,\theta}u)(n) = u(n+1)+u(n-1) + v(\theta+n\alpha)u(n) \] acting on $\ell^2(\mathbb Z)$, where $\alpha\notin\mathbb Q$ and $v\in C^2(\mathbb T,\mathbb R)$ is an even function. We develop a new Gordon-type method that exploits approximate repetitions and palindromic symmetries simultaneously. Denote by $L(E)$ the Lyapunov exponent and let \[\beta(\alpha) = \limsup_{|k|\to\infty} -\frac{\log\|k\alpha\|_{\mathbb R/\mathbb Z}}{|k|}. \] We prove that, for every completely resonant phase $2\theta\in\alpha\mathbb Z+\mathbb Z$, $E$ cannot be an eigenvalue if $L(E)<2\beta(\alpha)$. As an application, consider the almost Mathieu operator \[ (H_{\lambda,\alpha,\theta}u)(n) = u(n+1)+u(n-1) + 2\lambda\cos\bigl(2\pi(\theta+n\alpha)\bigr)u(n). \] We show that if $2\theta\in\alpha\mathbb Z+\mathbb Z$ and $1<|\lambda|<e^{2\beta(\alpha)}$, then $H_{\lambda,\alpha,\theta}$ has purely singular continuous spectrum. This resolves the remaining absence-of-eigenvalues part of a conjecture of Avila and Jitomirskaya concerning the sharp spectral transition for completely resonant phases.
summary: 我们考虑单频准周期薛定谔算子 \[ (H_{v,\alpha,\theta}u)(n) = u(n+1)+u(n-1) + v(\theta+n\alpha)u(n) \] 作用于 $\ell^2(\mathbb Z)$，其中 $\alpha\notin\mathbb Q$ 和 $v\in C^2(\mathbb T,\mathbb R)$ 是偶函数。我们开发了一种新的戈登型方法，同时利用近似重复和回文对称性。用 $L(E)$ 表示李雅普诺夫指数，并设 \[\beta(\alpha) = \limsup_{|k|\to\infty} -\frac{\log\|k\alpha\|_{\mathbb R/\mathbb Z}}{|k|}。 \] 我们证明，对于每个完全谐振相位 $2\theta\in\alpha\mathbb Z+​​\mathbb Z$，如果 $L(E)<2\beta(\alpha)$，$E$ 不能是特征值。作为一个应用，考虑近似马蒂厄运算符 \[ (H_{\lambda,\alpha,\theta}u)(n) = u(n+1)+u(n-1) + 2\lambda\cos\bigl(2\pi(\theta+n\alpha)\bigr)u(n)。 \] 我们证明，如果 $2\theta\in\alpha\mathbb Z+​​\mathbb Z$ 且 $1<|\lambda|<e^{2\beta(\alpha)}$，则 $H_{\lambda,\alpha,\theta}$ 具有纯奇异连续谱。这解决了 Avila 和 Jitomirskaya 关于完全谐振相的急剧光谱转变的猜想中剩余的特征值缺失部分。

title: Milnor metric for Morse--Smale flows from field theory
abstract: We study the partition function of Abelian $BF$ theory with an axial gauge fixing condition given by a Morse--Smale vector field, and we show that it recovers the Milnor metric on the determinant line on the twisted cohomology of the manifold. To do this we use the Batalin--Vilkovisky formalism and, in particular, a BV pushforward to cohomology in two steps. In this context, the Milnor metric serves as the generalisation of the Ruelle dynamical zeta function evaluated at zero for systems containing both closed orbits and critical points. This, together with a classic result due to Schwarz on the partition function of $BF$ theory in the Lorenz gauge, provides a field-theoretic realisation of Fried's conjecture, which is true for Morse--Smale flows.
summary: 我们研究了阿贝尔$BF$理论的配分函数，在Morse--Smale向量场给出的轴向规范固定条件下，我们证明它可以恢复流形扭曲上同调行列式线上的Milnor度量。为此，我们使用 Batalin-Vilkovisky 形式主义，特别是分两步将 BV 推进到上同调。在这种情况下，Milnor 度量是 Ruelle 动力学 zeta 函数的推广，对于包含闭合轨道和临界点的系统，其评估值为零。这与施瓦茨关于洛伦兹规范中$BF$理论的配分函数的经典结果一起，提供了弗里德猜想的场论实现，这对于莫尔斯-斯梅尔流来说是正确的。

title: A turning point principle for liquid Lane-Emden stars
abstract: Upon fixing the adiabatic index, the spherically symmetric liquid Lane-Emden stars governed by the Euler-Poisson system with a "stiffened gas" equation of state $p=\rho^\gamma-1$ form a one-parameter family, naturally parametrised by the central density $\kappa=\bar\rho_\kappa(0)\in(1,\infty)$. In contrast to the gaseous case, the liquid free boundary breaks the self-similarity of the family and bends the mass-radius curve, creating extrema of the mass when $\gamma<2(d-1)/d$. We formulate a turning point principle in the spirit of Zel'dovich, Wheeler and Thorne, and of its rigorous relativistic counterpart from the works of Hadžić, Lin and Rein: the number of radial growing modes equals the negative Morse index of the linearised operator, is locally constant along the family, and can change only at the turning points of the mass-radius curve, the bending orientation there dictating whether a growing mode is gained or lost. We describe the large central density limit in which the gaseous tail (read off from a planar dynamical system) determines whether the mass-radius curve spirals, and hence whether the number of growing modes remains bounded or tends to infinity. As corollaries we recover and sharpen the known radial (in)stability results for liquid Lane-Emden stars and, in combination with existing non-radial analysis, obtain a turning point criterion for non-radial stability.
summary:
确定绝热指数后，由具有“硬化气体”状态方程 $p=\rho^\gamma-1$ 的欧拉-泊松系统控制的球对称液体莱恩-埃姆登星形成一个单参数族，自然地由中心密度 $\kappa=\bar\rho_\kappa(0)\in(1,\infty)$ 参数化。与气体情况相反，液体自由边界破坏了族的自相似性，并使质量半径曲线弯曲，当 $\gamma<2(d-1)/d$ 时产生质量极值。我们本着 Zel'dovich、Wheeler 和 Thorne 的精神，以及 Hadžić、Lin 和 Rein 的著作中严格的相对论对应物的精神，制定了转折点原理：径向生长模式的数量等于线性算子的负莫尔斯指数，沿族局部恒定，并且只能在质量半径曲线的转折点处改变，那里的弯曲方向决定是否获得或失去生长模式。我们描述了大中心密度极限，其中气体尾部（从平面动力系统读取）决定了质量半径曲线是否螺旋，从而决定了生长模式的数量是否保持有界或趋于无穷大。

作为推论，我们恢复并锐化了已知的液态莱恩-埃姆登星的径向（不）稳定性结果，并结合现有的非径向分析，获得了非径向稳定性的转折点标准。

title: Wigner negativity and stellar rank for SU(1,1) states
abstract: Quasiprobability distributions for systems endowed with SU(1,1) dynamical symmetry have received surprisingly little attention, despite the central role of this symmetry in two-photon physics, squeezed states, and nonlinear interferometry. Here, we fill this gap by constructing a full covariant family of $s$-ordered quasiprobability distributions defined on the two-sheeted hyperboloid, or equivalently, on the Poincaré unit disk via stereographic projection. A key result is that the Wigner function is strictly positive for all Perelomov SU(1,1) coherent states, in sharp contrast to the SU(2) case. This positivity endows Wigner negativity with an unambiguous operational meaning: any negative volume is a direct signature of genuinely quantum behavior. We further examine the stellar rank of SU(1,1) states, defined through the zeros of the Husimi $Q$-function, and show how it compares with Wigner negativity as a geometry-adapted witness of nonclassicality in this setting. We further introduce a hierarchy of generalized multipoles through a harmonic expansion of the density operator on the hyperboloid, providing a complementary framework for probing quantumness. This offers a comprehensive toolkit for characterizing and quantifying quantum resources in SU(1,1) systems.
summary:
尽管这种对称性在双光子物理、压缩态和非线性干涉测量中发挥着核心作用，但具有 SU(1,1) 动力学对称性的系统的准概率分布却很少受到关注。在这里，我们通过构建在两片双曲面上定义的 $s$ 有序准概率分布的完整协变族来填补这一空白，或者等效地，通过立体投影在庞加莱单位圆盘上定义。一个关键结果是，维格纳函数对于所有 Perelomov SU(1,1) 相干态都是严格正的，这与 SU(2) 情况形成鲜明对比。这种正性赋予维格纳负性以明确的操作意义：任何负体积都是真正量子行为的直接签名。我们进一步研究了通过 Husimi $Q$ 函数的零点定义的 SU(1,1) 态的恒星等级，并展示了它如何与作为这种情况下非经典性的几何适应见证的维格纳负性进行比较。我们通过双曲面上密度算子的调和展开进一步引入了广义多极子的层次结构，为探测量子性提供了补充框架。

这提供了一个用于表征和量化 SU(1,1) 系统中量子资源的综合工具包。

title: Practical advantage beyond the quadratic speedup limit with fully-quantum walks
abstract: We introduce a new class of fully-quantum Metropolis walks in which both the proposal and acceptance steps are intrinsically quantum. Unlike standard quantum walks obtained by quantizing classically efficient Markov chains, our algorithm employs Hamiltonian simulation as a quantum-native proposal mechanism, enlarging the class of quantum walks beyond classical counterparts. We target the problem of sampling from the low-temperature Gibbs distribution of classical dense Ising models, within a fixed error in total variation distance. This approach achieves about a cubic polynomial asymptotic advantage over previous quantum-walks, resulting in a total sixth-degree polynomial queries speedup compared to the best classical walk. This shows that speedups beyond the widely assumed quadratic limit are possible within the quantum walk formalism. We perform a complete fault-tolerant compilation of all algorithmic primitives and benchmark against CPU, GPU, and FPGA implementations of the best classical Markov chain. Under identical hardware assumptions, the resulting advantage runtime crossover is reduced from approximately $10^3$ years for conventional quantum walks to less than one day. These results identify fully-quantum Markov chains as a promising route toward practical quantum advantage.
summary:
我们引入了一类新的全量子大都会行走，其中提案和接受步骤本质上都是量子的。与通过量化经典有效马尔可夫链获得的标准量子游走不同，我们的算法采用哈密顿模拟作为量子原生提议机制，将量子游走的类别扩大到经典对应物之外。我们的目标是在总变异距离的固定误差范围内从经典密集伊辛模型的低温吉布斯分布中采样的问题。与之前的量子行走相比，这种方法实现了大约三次多项式渐近优势，与最佳经典行走相比，总体六次多项式查询加速。这表明在量子行走形式主义中，超越广泛假设的二次极限的加速是可能的。我们对所有算法原语进行完整的容错编译，并针对最佳经典马尔可夫链的 CPU、GPU 和 FPGA 实现进行基准测试。在相同的硬件假设下，所产生的优势运行时间交叉从传统量子行走的大约 10^3 美元年减少到不到一天。

这些结果表明，全量子马尔可夫链是实现实际量子优势的一条有希望的途径。

title: Bias-preserving cat-cat CNOT gate via vacuum-conditional beam-splitter
abstract: Cat qubits can exhibit strong noise bias due to their exponentially enhanced bit-flip times and only polynomially reduced phase-flip times with increasing photon number, which makes them attractive candidates for hardware-efficient quantum error correction. However, it is difficult to maintain this strong noise bias in logical operations such as CNOT gates between cats. Here, we propose a coherent CNOT gate scheme between two dissipative cats that preserves the exponential noise bias. The proposed gate relies only on unitary operations, which avoids the non-idealities associated with many existing gate schemes that rely on engineered dissipations. Assuming good component lifetimes and precise nonlinearity engineering, the proposed gate can enable logical memory in the megaquop regime (logical error rates < 10^-6) with a distance-7 repetition code consisting of 13 cat qubits.
summary: Cat 量子位可以表现出很强的噪声偏差，因为它们的位翻转时间呈指数增强，并且随着光子数量的增加，相位翻转时间仅以多项式方式减少，这使得它们成为硬件高效量子纠错的有吸引力的候选者。然而，在猫之间的 CNOT 门等逻辑运算中很难维持这种强烈的噪声偏差。在这里，我们提出了两只耗散猫之间的相干 CNOT 门方案，以保留指数噪声偏差。所提出的门仅依赖于单一操作，这避免了与许多依赖于工程耗散的现有门方案相关的非理想性。假设良好的组件寿命和精确的非线性工程，所提出的门可以使用由 13 个 cat 量子位组成的距离 7 重复码，实现百万级状态下的逻辑存储器（逻辑错误率 < 10^-6）。

title: Universal scaling framework for parameterized quantum evolutions at criticality
abstract: Variational ansätze are a cornerstone of quantum many-body physics, providing compact approximations to complex ground states using finite resources. Recent quantum-technology advances have introduced a new class based on layered parameterized evolutions. Assessing whether they can represent critical ground states is challenging: correlations span all length scales, while finite circuit depth limits how far they extend. Building on finite-resource scaling from tensor networks, we assign each ansatz an emergent correlation length $\xi_D$, the longest range over which it faithfully captures critical correlations. Its growth with refinement parameter $D$, $\xi_D \propto D^\kappa$, defines an exponent $\kappa$ measuring how efficiently an architecture converts resources into long-distance correlations. Applying this framework to the critical transverse-field Ising model, with $D$ the circuit depth of parameterized evolutions, we compare ansätze with nearest-neighbor and long-range generators, and layers where generators act separately or combined. All ansätze are compatible with algebraic growth, but fitted exponents range from $\kappa\simeq1$ to $\kappa\simeq3$. Exponential interactions give the largest exponents, while power-law interactions stay close to nearest-neighbor behavior, showing long-range support alone gives no scaling advantage. Combined-generator layers generally outperform separable ones, so layer organization matters alongside interaction range. Finally, a quasiparticle analysis shows finite depth leaves an unresolved window of width $\xi_D^{-1}$ around the low-energy modes responsible for long-distance correlations. The emergent correlation length thus acts as an infrared resolution scale, providing a benchmark for critical-state preparation and a guide for designing resource-efficient variational architectures.
summary:
变分分析是量子多体物理的基石，使用有限资源提供复杂基态的紧凑近似。最近的量子技术进步引入了一种基于分层参数化演化的新类别。评估它们是否可以代表关键基态具有挑战性：相关性跨越所有长度尺度，而有限的电路深度限制了它们延伸的距离。基于张量网络的有限资源扩展，我们为每个 ansatz 分配一个紧急相关长度 $\xi_D$，这是它忠实捕获关键相关性的最长范围。它随着细化参数 $D$、$\xi_D \propto D^\kappa$ 的增长，定义了一个指数 $\kappa$ 来衡量架构将资源转换为长距离相关性的效率。将此框架应用于临界横向场 Ising 模型，其中 $D$ 为参数化演化的电路深度，我们将 ansätze 与最近邻和远程发电机以及发电机单独或组合作用的层进行比较。所有 ansätze 都与代数增长兼容，但拟合指数范围从 $\kappa\simeq1$ 到 $\kappa\simeq3$。

指数相互作用给出最大的指数，而幂律相互作用保持接近最近邻行为，仅显示远程支持不具有缩放优势。组合生成器层通常优于可分离生成器层，因此层组织与交互范围一样重要。最后，准粒子分析表明，有限深度在负责长距离相关的低能模式周围留下了宽度 $\xi_D^{-1}$ 的未解析窗口。因此，出现的相关长度充当红外分辨率尺度，为临界状态准备提供基准，并为设计资源高效的变分架构提供指南。

title: A Resource Estimation Model for the Hardware-Software Co-Design of Distributed Quantum Architectures
abstract: In distributed quantum computing (DQC), executing monolithic quantum circuits across multiple interconnected quantum processing units (QPUs) requires dedicated communication qubits to generate and distribute entanglement. Because the number of physical qubits within a QPU is finite, a trade-off emerges where allocating more communication qubits increases the capacity of quantum channels for concurrent non-local operations, but reduces the number of computational qubits available for local gate operations. Distributed quantum compilation routinely ignores this channel capacity, while hardware architects lack a method to determine it prior to quantum circuit partitioning. Moreover, scheduling entanglement on demand introduces severe latency, whereas pre-fetching exposes stored pairs to decoherence. We propose an economic order quantity model from perishable inventory theory to optimize the trade-off between entanglement distribution latency and the time cost of decoherence. The resulting estimate is driven by algorithmic demand and physical constraints, offering a dual application for the hardware-software co-design of high-performance DQC: for hardware architects, it gives the optimal allocation of dedicated communication qubits in static heterogeneous architectures; for compiler developers, it gives the optimal number to reserve dynamically in homogeneous architectures.
summary:
在分布式量子计算 (DQC) 中，跨多个互连的量子处理单元 (QPU) 执行单片量子电路需要专用通信量子位来生成和分布纠缠。由于 QPU 内的物理量子位数量是有限的，因此会出现一种权衡，即分配更多通信量子位会增加并发非本地操作的量子通道的容量，但会减少可用于本地门操作的计算量子位的数量。分布式量子编译通常会忽略此通道容量，而硬件架构师缺乏在量子电路分区之前确定它的方法。此外，按需调度纠缠会带来严重的延迟，而预取会使存储的对出现退相干。我们从易腐烂库存理论中提出了一种经济订单量模型，以优化纠缠分配延迟和退相干时间成本之间的权衡。

由此产生的估计是由算法需求和物理约束驱动的，为高性能 DQC 的软硬件协同设计提供了双重应用：对于硬件架构师来说，它给出了静态异构架构中专用通信量子位的最佳分配；对于编译器开发人员来说，它给出了在同构架构中动态保留的最佳数量。

title: Revisiting the invariant ring of two-qubit mixed states
abstract: Local unitary equivalence serves as the cornerstone for classifying entanglement in bipartite quantum systems. Mathematically, it reduces to the study of polynomial invariants of the density matrix under the action of local unitary groups. The collection of all such polynomial invariants forms a ring, known as the invariant ring. However, identifying the complete generators of the invariant ring is the central issue. In 2007, for the two-qubit system, King et al fully characterized the structure of the invariant ring and determined its Cohen--Macaulay decomposition. In this paper, we revisit their work, with a focus on the computation of the Molien series and the construction of invariants. On one hand, we rigorously derive the Molien series via explicit contour integration over the maximal torus, filling in all previously omitted computational steps. On the other hand, we systematically construct all invariants using a graphical method, and then reduce the candidate set by applying various identities and algebraic relations, obtaining a generating set consisting of 21 invariants. This paper aims to make this important result more widely accessible to researchers in quantum information and invariant theory through the above discussions.
summary:
局域酉等价是对二分量子系统中的纠缠进行分类的基石。在数学上，它简化为对局部酉群作用下密度矩阵多项式不变量的研究。所有此类多项式不变量的集合形成一个环，称为不变量环。然而，识别不变环的完整生成元是核心问题。 2007年，对于二量子比特系统，King等人全面表征了不变环的结构，并确定了其Cohen-Macaulay分解。在本文中，我们重新审视他们的工作，重点是莫连级数的计算和不变量的构造。一方面，我们通过最大圆环上的显式轮廓积分严格推导莫连级数，填充所有先前省略的计算步骤。另一方面，我们使用图解方法系统地构造所有不变量，然后通过应用各种恒等式和代数关系来减少候选集，获得由21个不变量组成的生成集。

本文旨在通过上述讨论，让量子信息和不变量理论的研究人员更广泛地了解这一重要成果。

title: The Ruskai-Audenaert conjecture & equipartitions of positive operators
abstract: Several open problems in quantum information theory can be formulated as equipartition problems for positive operators, asking for a decomposition into bounded-rank positive parts under uniform constraints. The existence problems for SIC-POVMs and MUBs are of this type, as is the Ruskai-Audenaert conjecture. We first show that certain problems of this form can be attacked using equivariant cohomology, and then present new results on the Ruskai-Audenaert conjecture. In its weak form, this conjecture asserts that every quantum channel admits a convex decomposition into a minimal number of generalized extreme points; in its strong form, one with equal weights. We prove the strong conjecture in all dimensions for a set of channels of nonzero measure, including all cq- and qc-channels, as well as for all channels with qubit inputs. We also prove the weak conjecture for all qutrit channels, along with further results on convex decompositions of quantum channels.
summary: 量子信息论中的几个开放问题可以表述为正算子的均分问题，要求在统一约束下分解为有界秩正部分。 SIC-POVM 和 MUB 的存在问题属于此类，Ruskai-Audenaert 猜想也是如此。我们首先证明这种形式的某些问题可以使用等变上同调来解决，然后提出鲁斯凯-奥德纳特猜想的新结果。在其弱形式中，该猜想断言每个量子通道都允许凸分解为最少数量的广义极值点；以其坚固的形式，具有相同的重量。我们在所有维度上证明了一组非零测量通道的强猜想，包括所有 cq 和 qc 通道，以及具有量子位输入的所有通道。我们还证明了所有 qutrit 通道的弱猜想，以及量子通道凸分解的进一步结果。

title: Digital techniques for the frustrated Ising ring: the role of counter-diabatic terms
abstract: We investigate the role of local counter-diabatic (CD) terms in enhancing the performance of discrete-time digital protocols for a frustrated Ising ring, a system with an exponentially small spectral gap that acts as a bottleneck for conventional quantum annealing. The techniques investigated range from a digitised version of a fixed-schedule protocol, including lowest-order analytical CD terms, all the way to a full-fledged Quantum Approximate Optimisation Algorithm (QAOA), including variational CD terms (DC-QAOA). By analyzing the resulting residual energy, we show that DC-QAOA combined with Chopped RAndom Basis (CRAB) quantum control techniques for optimizing the circuit parameters, can outperform all the other strategies. By monitoring the ground-state population during the dynamics we learn that DC-QAOA finds effective shortcuts towards the target state through intermediate excited states, a process that is unexpectedly enhanced by the inclusion of local CD unitaries. Our results highlight the importance of flexible variational control of CD dynamics and demonstrate that digital optimization can explore operator dynamics that remain inaccessible to standard analytical CD constructions.
summary:
我们研究了局域反绝热（CD）项在增强受挫伊辛环离散时间数字协议性能方面的作用，伊辛环是一个具有指数级小光谱间隙的系统，是传统量子退火的瓶颈。研究的技术范围从固定时间表协议的数字化版本（包括最低阶分析 CD 项）一直到成熟的量子近似优化算法 (QAOA)，包括变分 CD 项 (DC-QAOA)。通过分析所得的剩余能量，我们表明 DC-QAOA 与斩波随机基础 (CRAB) 量子控制技术相结合来优化电路参数，可以优于所有其他策略。通过监测动态过程中的基态布居，我们了解到 DC-QAOA 通过中间激发态找到了通往目标态的有效捷径，这一过程通过包含局部 CD 酉而意外得到增强。

我们的结果强调了 CD 动力学的灵活变分控制的重要性，并证明数字优化可以探索标准分析 CD 结构仍然无法访问的操作员动力学。

title: Nested Integral Generator Theorem: From Operator Tautologies to Families of Exact Integral Identities
abstract: Inserting resolutions of the identity is a standard technique for representing states and operators throughout quantum theory, quantum field theory, and related areas of mathematical physics. This paper elevates this procedure to a rigorous, representation-independent framework through the Nested Integral Generator Theorem. Starting from operator tautologies, the theorem systematically generates exact multi-fold integral identities by successive insertions of continuous resolutions of the identity followed by projection onto arbitrary orthonormal basis vectors. The resulting construction applies to arbitrary finite compositions of closed operators acting on arbitrary target states and establishes a general mapping from operator equalities to families of exact integral identities. Using the theory of vector-valued integration, explicit and verifiable sufficient conditions are derived under which inner products may be interchanged rigorously with Bochner integrals, thereby placing a step that is often left implicit in the physics literature on a firm mathematical foundation. As an immediate consequence, the theorem yields exact integral representations for individual operator functions. Its scope is illustrated through elementary, polynomial, and analytic single-mode operators, as well as single- and two-mode Gaussian unitaries, including squeezing and beam splitting. The framework is further applied to two nontrivial examples beyond standard Gaussian calculations: an exact integral representation of a Kerr-squeezed coherent-state overlap and exact Fock-basis matrix elements for a composite two-mode Gaussian network expressed in terms of bivariate Hermite polynomials.
summary:
插入恒等式分辨率是在量子理论、量子场论和数学物理相关领域中表示状态和算子的标准技术。本文通过嵌套积分生成器定理将该过程提升为严格的、与表示无关的框架。从算子同义反复开始，该定理通过连续插入恒等式的连续分辨率，然后投影到任意正交基向量上，系统地生成精确的多重积分恒等式。由此产生的构造适用于作用于任意目标状态的封闭算子的任意有限组合，并建立从算子等式到精确积分恒等式族的一般映射。利用向量值积分理论，导出了明确且可验证的充分条件，在这些条件下，内积可以与博赫纳积分严格互换，从而将物理学文献中经常隐含的步骤置于坚实的数学基础上。

直接的结果是，该定理产生了各个算子函数的精确积分表示。其范围通过初等、多项式和解析单模算子以及单模和双模高斯酉（包括挤压和分束）来说明。该框架进一步应用于标准高斯计算之外的两个重要示例：克尔压缩相干态重叠的精确积分表示和以双变量埃尔米特多项式表示的复合双模高斯网络的精确福克基矩阵元素。

title: Gravitational acceleration encoded in Jaynes Cummings exchange frequencies: Quantum Fisher information, readout, and validity conditions
abstract: We derive an effective trapped atom--cavity model in which a constant gravitational acceleration shifts the oscillator equilibrium and changes the local standing-wave coupling, thereby encoding the acceleration in the Jaynes Cummings exchange frequencies. With the atom and motion initially in their ground states and the cavity field initially coherent, we solve the closed-system carrier dynamics exactly and derive the displaced-frame quantum Fisher information (QFI) of the joint atom-cavity state. This QFI is proportional to the square of the local coupling slope, grows quadratically with interrogation time, and scales linearly with mean photon number. At the node, phase-referenced Ramsey detection gives a sign-sensitive estimate of axial acceleration and locally saturates the joint QFI. Away from the node, photon counting and phase-optimized homodyne detection provide cavity readouts when the cavity state carries more QFI than the atomic state. At the off-node operating point studied, Lindblad simulations show that cavity loss produces a finite-time QFI optimum. Lamb Dicke and sideband-suppression conditions control the carrier approximation. In the closed-system benchmark, the carrier-model QFI agrees with the atom-cavity QFI obtained from the unexpanded model after tracing out motion.
summary:
我们推导出一个有效的俘获原子腔模型，其中恒定的重力加速度会改变振荡器平衡并改变局部驻波耦合，从而编码杰恩斯·卡明斯交换频率中的加速度。在原子和运动最初处于基态以及空腔场最初相干的情况下，我们精确地求解了闭系统载流子动力学，并推导出原子-空腔联合态的位移框架量子费希尔信息（QFI）。该 QFI 与局部耦合斜率的平方成正比，随询问时间呈二次方增长，并与平均光子数成线性比例。在节点处，相位参考 Ramsey 检测给出了轴向加速度的符号敏感估计，并使联合 QFI 局部饱和。远离节点，当腔态比原子态携带更多 QFI 时，光子计数和相位优化的零差检测可提供腔读数。在研究的离节点工作点，Lindblad 模拟表明，空腔损耗产生有限时间 QFI 最佳值。 Lamb Dicke 和边带抑制条件控制载波近似。

在封闭系统基准测试中，载体模型 QFI 与追踪运动后从未展开模型获得的原子腔 QFI 一致。

title: Performance Analysis of QAOA Across Distributed Quantum Network Topologies Using SwitchQNet
abstract: Quantum data-center (QDC) architectures aim to scale distributed quantum computing (DQC) by interconnecting multiple quantum processing units (QPUs), but their performance depends strongly on how algorithmic communication patterns interact with entanglement generation, switch reconfiguration, and network topology. This paper studies the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) as a graph-structured optimization workload for QDC-based distributed quantum computing. We adapt QAOA to SwitchQNet, a distributed quantum compiler framework that schedules communication and entanglement generation over switch-based QDC networks, by adding a routing generator that converts graph-dependent two-qubit cost interactions into remote-CX communication requests across QPUs. Using this extension, we evaluate QAOA instances across Clos, fat-tree, and spine-leaf topologies, measuring communication latency, EPR-pair overhead, EPR wait time, retry overhead, and sensitivity to buffer size, look-ahead depth, communication-qubit count, EPR latency, and EPR fidelity assumptions. The results show that QAOA obtains modest but consistent latency reductions, highlighting its value as a diagnostic benchmark for studying the interaction between algorithm structure, entanglement management, and quantum-network architecture.
summary:
量子数据中心 (QDC) 架构旨在通过互连多个量子处理单元 (QPU) 来扩展分布式量子计算 (DQC)，但其性能在很大程度上取决于算法通信模式如何与纠缠生成、交换机重新配置和网络拓扑交互。本文研究了量子近似优化算法（QAOA）作为基于 QDC 的分布式量子计算的图结构优化工作负载。我们将 QAOA 适应 SwitchQNet，这是一个分布式量子编译器框架，通过添加路由生成器来调度基于开关的 QDC 网络上的通信和纠缠生成，该路由生成器将图相关的两个量子位成本交互转换为跨 QPU 的远程 CX 通信请求。使用此扩展，我们跨 Clos、胖树和脊叶拓扑评估 QAOA 实例，测量通信延迟、EPR 对开销、EPR 等待时间、重试开销以及对缓冲区大小、前瞻深度、通信量子位计数、EPR 延迟和 EPR 保真度假设的敏感度。

结果表明，QAOA 获得了适度但一致的延迟减少，突出了其作为研究算法结构、纠缠管理和量子网络架构之间相互作用的诊断基准的价值。

title: Multiconfigurational Mixed Quantum-Classical Approach for Correlated Many-Body Dynamics
abstract: In this work, we introduce a multiconfigurational mixed quantum-classical many-body approach for simulating the finite-temperature correlated multi-exciton dynamics in the presence of phonon-induced static and dynamic disorder. In this mixed quantum-classical approach, the excitonic subsystem is described using a multiconfigurational wavefunction that extends beyond the mean-field limit, while the phonons are evolved quasi-classically. Using this approach, we simulate a multi-excitonic dissipative system and show how the interplay between phonon-induced dynamic disorder and exciton-exciton many-body interactions determines excitation-dependent excitonic transport and spatial correlations. Our results show that while the mean-field approach produces semi-quantitatively accurate diffusive dynamics, it does not capture the spatial correlations as expected. We find that a mean-field path approximation, where we generate pre-computed trajectories using our mean-field mixed quantum-classical approach and then perform multiconfigurational dynamics, can reproduce the spatial correlations to a good accuracy, positioning this approach as an efficient method for capturing spatial correlations in complex systems.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们引入了一种多构型混合量子经典多体方法，用于模拟存在声子引起的静态和动态无序的情况下的有限温度相关多激子动力学。在这种混合量子经典方法中，激子子系统使用超出平均场极限的多构型波函数来描述，而声子则以准经典方式演化。使用这种方法，我们模拟了多激子耗散系统，并展示了声子引起的动态无序和激子-激子多体相互作用之间的相互作用如何决定激发依赖性激子输运和空间相关性。我们的结果表明，虽然平均场方法产生半定量准确的扩散动力学，但它并没有像预期那样捕获空间相关性。

我们发现，平均场路径近似（使用平均场混合量子经典方法生成预先计算的轨迹，然后执行多配置动力学）可以以良好的精度再现空间相关性，将该方法定位为捕获复杂系统中空间相关性的有效方法。

title: A partial-trace matrix inequality and Werner-state distillability
abstract: Motivated by the equivalent partial-trace formulations of Werner-state distillability [P. Costa Rico, Lett. Math. Phys. 115, 47 (2025); S.-Y. Qi et al., Phys. Rev. A 110, 012406 (2024)], we prove a bipartite partial-trace inequality for every matrix of rank at most two. As applications, we prove the two-copy undistillability of NPT Werner states in arbitrary local dimension, thereby resolving this open problem highlighted in [P. Horodecki et al., PRX Quantum 3, 010101 (2022)]. We further prove a two-parameter extension of the matrix inequality and show that two individually one-copy-undistillable NPT Werner states cannot activate each other's one-copy distillability. We also resolve the singular-value maximization problem associated with the two-ququart case.
summary: 受到维尔纳状态蒸馏性的等效部分痕量公式的启发 [P。哥斯达黎各，莱特。数学。物理。 115, 47 (2025)； S.-Y。齐等人，物理学。 Rev. A 110, 012406 (2024)]，我们证明了每个秩最多为二的矩阵的二部偏迹不等式。作为应用，我们证明了 NPT Werner 态在任意局部维度上的二拷贝不可蒸馏性，从而解决了 [P. Horodecki 等人，PRX Quantum 3, 010101 (2022)]。我们进一步证明了矩阵不等式的双参数扩展，并表明两个单独的单拷贝不可蒸馏的 NPT Werner 状态不能激活彼此的单拷贝可蒸馏性。我们还解决了与两夸夸特情况相关的奇异值最大化问题。

title: A strong converse for stabilizer codes over Pauli channels via the blowing-up lemma
abstract: We prove a strong converse for quantum communication over Pauli channels within the class of stabilizer codes. If a code whose code space is a full joint eigenspace of a stabilizer group transmits above the coherent information of its own input state, its entanglement fidelity decays exponentially in the block length; the encoder may be any isometry onto that space and the decoder any channel. For memoryless channels this determines the $\varepsilon$-quantum capacity of the class for every $\varepsilon < 1$, so that tolerating a constant error buys no rate; for antidegradable channels, such as the depolarizing channel with error probability $p \in [1/4, 3/4]$, that capacity is zero, while for $p \in [1/4,1/2)$ partial-transposition bounds provably cannot certify a strong converse. The proof uses neither additivity assumptions nor semidefinite relaxations: optimal decoding succeeds precisely on an event in a product probability space, so the blowing-up lemma of Ahlswede, Gács and Körner applies, and the side information it produces is charged against the coherent information. The argument also constrains near-deterministic decoding for codes of any kind, and we isolate the encoder-side statement that would extend it to all of them.
summary:
我们证明了稳定器代码类别中通过泡利通道进行量子通信的强有力的逆过程。如果一个码空间是稳定器组的全联合本征空间的码在其自身输入状态的相干信息之上传输，则其纠缠保真度在块长度上呈指数衰减；编码器可以是该空间上的任何等距，解码器可以是任何通道。对于无记忆通道，这决定了每个 $\varepsilon < 1$ 的类的 $\varepsilon$ 量子容量，因此容忍恒定误差不会购买任何速率；对于抗降解通道，例如误差概率为 $p \in [1/4, 3/4]$ 的去极化通道，该容量为零，而对于 $p \in [1/4,1/2)$ 部分转置界限可能无法证明强逆。该证明既不使用可加性假设，也不使用半定松弛：最优解码在乘积概率空间中的事件上精确地成功，因此适用 Ahlswede、Gács 和 Körner 的爆炸引理，并且它产生的辅助信息与相干信息相对应。

该论点还限制了对任何类型的代码的近确定性解码，并且我们隔离了将其扩展到所有代码的编码器端语句。

title: A Probabilistic Representation for Multi-State Discrete-time Quantum Walks
abstract: Building upon the pioneering framework of Vu (2026), we construct a probabilistic representation for three-state discrete-time quantum walks on integer lattices and validate it through empirical examples. Furthermore, we establish that this representation converges to the continuum solution of multi-state Dirac partial differential equations. Broadly, our findings demonstrate that this probabilistic paradigm serves as a robust alternative for simulating higher-dimensional quantum walks, opening new theoretical avenues to analyze quantum dynamics using classical stochastic processes.
